paper_role: independent individual-level mechanism test for the Palmer late-season colony-state hypothesis

resight.title: Adelie penguin resighting data 1997-2021 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science

banding.title: Adelie penguin banding data 1994-2021 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science
banding.role: natal colony and cohort/age source if not already carried in the resight table

independent_colony_performance_candidate.title: Adelie penguin chick counts 1997-2009 from the California Avian Data Center hosted by Point Reyes Bird Observatory Conservation Science
independent_colony_performance_candidate.role: preferred independent colony-year late-season state if its schema permits an objective colony-level performance quantity

published_mark_recapture_design: Ross Island study covers Cape Royds, Cape Bird and Cape Crozier.
Chicks were individually banded and colonies searched repeatedly during breeding seasons.
Every resighting recorded band identity and breeding status; nests of breeders were relocated to determine reproductive outcome.
Published analysis classifies states as unobservable, pre-breeder, breeder and non-breeder combined with colony location.
Pre-breeder movement among colonies is materially more common than breeder movement; breeder movement is <0.2%.
not_novel: Estimating age-specific recruitment, breeding propensity or colony-transition probabilities in these data.
Showing that pre-breeders move among Ross Island colonies more than established breeders.
known_before_data_access.target_novelty: Test whether recent biological performance of a colony predicts individual prospecting-to-first-breeding settlement choices, rather than merely describing movement rates.

allowed: unique-value labels without frequencies for categorical code dictionaries
whether individual ID, date/year, colony, reproductive state, nesting status and reproductive outcome fields exist
whether banding data provide natal colony and banding year
prohibited: selection of years, states, colonies or code mappings based on movement outcomes

gate_decisions.GO_prebreeder_choice: Require stable individual ID, observation season/year, observed colony, and a reproductive-state or nest-status field that objectively distinguishes pre-breeder observations from first breeding. Natal colony/age must be recoverable either from the resight or banding dataset.
gate_decisions.GO_adult_retention_secondary: Require stable individual ID, breeding colony in consecutive years, breeding status, and documented survey years. This route is secondary because published breeder movement is extremely rare.
gate_decisions.PERFORMANCE_SOURCE_GATE_REQUIRED: If individual movement schema passes but resight data lack an objective colony-year reproductive-performance field, do not inspect movement outcomes until an independent performance source is schema-audited and its predictor definition is frozen.
gate_decisions.STOP: If individual identity, colony, or reproductive-state semantics cannot be established objectively, do not use the dataset for the mechanism test.

preferred_individual_test_if_GO.name: prospecting-to-first-breeding settlement choice
eligibility: Known-age bird observed at age >=2 as a pre-breeder before first recorded breeding.
At least two Ross Island colonies are in that individual's observed prospecting choice set during the frozen lookback window.
First breeding colony is observed in a survey year with valid detection effort.
Candidate-colony performance is measured before first breeding.
preferred_individual_test_if_GO.prospecting_choice_set: Only colonies at which the individual was actually observed as a pre-breeder during the immediately preceding two breeding seasons. Do not define unvisited colonies as available choices in the primary model.
preferred_individual_test_if_GO.performance_lookback: For each candidate colony, use the most recent complete breeding-season performance state prior to the individual's first breeding season. Same-season post-settlement performance is prohibited.
preferred_individual_test_if_GO.primary_model: Conditional logistic choice model within individual first-breeding event: chosen_colony ~ z_recent_colony_performance + natal_colony_indicator + log_colony_size, with each individual's observed candidate set as the stratum.

primary_inference.permutation_null: Within each performance year, permute colony-performance labels among the three Ross Island colonies, rebuild individual candidate-set predictors, and refit the conditional choice model.
primary_inference.p_value: one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo p with +1 correction

P1_independent_colony_counts.source_candidate: USAP-DC 600007 chick counts plus an independently documented breeding-pair/census denominator if required by the source semantics.
P1_independent_colony_counts.rule: Freeze an objective colony-year late-season state before reading individual settlement outcomes.

P2_resight_breeder_outcomes.allowed_only_if: The resight schema contains individual breeder reproductive outcome and no suitable independent colony-performance source is available.
P2_resight_breeder_outcomes.state_definition: Aggregate reproductive outcome among banded breeders by colony-year, excluding any focal individual if it can contribute to that colony-year predictor.
P2_resight_breeder_outcomes.boundary: Label this a banded-breeder performance index, not whole-colony reproductive success.

performance_source_hierarchy.no_performance_source: If neither source is estimable under its frozen schema gate, stop the public-information test rather than substituting colony size, survival, or a post hoc environmental proxy.

adult_breeder_retention.question: Does prior colony performance predict whether an established breeder is next observed breeding at the same colony?
adult_breeder_retention.role: secondary because breeder dispersal is published as <0.2%; do not treat sparse events as primary evidence.
adult_breeder_retention.model: Multistate capture-recapture preferred. A conditional analysis among resighted breeders may be reported only as conditional on detection.

prebreeder_prospecting_location.question: Before first breeding, are high-performance colonies disproportionately included among colonies an individual visits?
prebreeder_prospecting_location.role: secondary because observation effort/detection may differ among colonies.

detection_and_missingness.bird_after_2013: Published methods state Cape Bird resighting effort became intermittent after 2013. Years without surveys must be coded unavailable/censored, not nondetection.
detection_and_missingness.nondetection: Never classify an unobserved bird as dead, emigrated, non-breeding, or absent from a colony without an explicit detection model.
detection_and_missingness.multiple_same_year_resights: Preserve all raw observations through schema audit. Any annual state-collapsing rule must be frozen before examining performance-conditioned transitions.

claim_boundaries: A positive prospecting-choice result would support performance-linked settlement among colonies actually visited by pre-breeders; it would not establish the sensory or social cue used.
Do not call the test a replication of Palmer reproductive success: Palmer's predictive variable is now conservatively termed a late-season colony-wide state.
Do not infer candidate availability from geographic proximity alone in the primary test.
Do not use same-season reproductive performance measured after settlement.
Do not replace the prospecting primary test with adult breeder dispersal if the prospecting endpoint is non-significant.
Do not tune state codes, lookback windows, minimum sample sizes, candidate sets or alpha after movement outcomes are opened.
